description: This file defines the EmploymentStatusService class, which provides methods for managing employment status entities including retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employment statuses, typically used within an HRM system.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusService
classes.description: Service class that acts as a bridge between the data access object (DAO) layer and the application, providing business logic functions related to employment statuses.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmploymentStatusDao instance.

methods.name: setEmploymentStatusDao
methods.description: Sets the EmploymentStatusDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmploymentStatus entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Persists an EmploymentStatus entity to storage.

methods.name: deleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Deletes employment statuses with specified IDs.

methods.name: searchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Searches for employment statuses based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employment statuses matching the search filters.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusArray
methods.description: Retrieves all employment statuses and returns them as a normalized array of EmploymentStatusModel objects.
